title: Vogue The World Of Ginny Doll Communion 8" VTG 1984 Poseable All Vinyl w/ Box
categoryName: Dolls & Bears:Dolls, Clothing & Accessories:Dolls & Doll Playsets
descriptionText: This is a vintage 1984 Vogue Ginny Doll measuring 8 inches tall. The doll features brown straight hair, green eyes, and a light complexion. She is dressed in a Communion outfit and comes in the original unopened box. Made of vinyl, this poseable doll is part of The Vogue Doll Company's product line and was manufactured in Hong Kong. A collectible piece for doll enthusiasts.
